description: Prevents source-page navigation, host branding, nearby listings, and legal-status language from becoming misleading public search keywords. These rules apply only to automated source-page inferences; canonical editor-reviewed keywords remain unchanged.

agriculture.reason: Do not classify tours, lodging, or recreation as agriculture merely because a page mentions a ranch.

chamber of commerce.reason: Directory host branding must not make every chamber member look like a chamber.

library.reason: A shop or program hosted on a library page is not automatically a library.

main street.reason: Street addresses and presenter names must not imply participation in a Main Street program.

nonprofit.reason: Legal or tax status requires an editor-reviewed canonical signal rather than contextual inference.

visitor center.reason: Tourism-page context must not turn another organization into a visitor center.

travel-guide-bobcat-pass-wilderness-adve.reason: The public page describes recreation and ranch activities; agriculture is not a useful directory route for this listing.

travel-guide-music-from-angel-fire-angel.reason: Angel Fire Chamber is the profile host, not Music from Angel Fire's organization type.

travel-guide-mesalands-cc-dinosaur-museu.reason: The tourism template supplies recreation language; the listing itself is a museum and educational attraction.

the-shuler-theater-colfax-performing-art.reason: Main Street Live is a presenter name on the events page, not evidence that the theater is a Main Street program.

dewitt-enterprises-huerfano-local-maker-.reason: The current profile describes a historical and collectible bookseller; surrounding maker and author language describes inventory or page context.

huerfano-heritage-center-huerfano-arts-c.reason: The center is an archive and research facility; navigation and collection descriptions must not reclassify it as a museum, newspaper, or visitor center.

travel-guide-books-and-more-trinidad-las.reason: Books & More is a used bookstore associated with the Friends of the Library, not the library itself.
